name: The Last Cairn
descriptionSeed: The Last Cairn is where the tending stops. The Ashwardens raised it as a marker, not a wall: past this stone nobody keeps the Palelands, and the Long Grey begins. Orsolya stands beside it. She was the first of the Unfinished, an Ashwarden who refused her own ending and did not get the road back either, and she has stood here for forty years still having the argument. She will talk with anyone who comes, and she is listening for a better reason than the one she has.
encounterFlavor: Orsolya, who will argue with you for as long as you like; mourners from Cairnsend leaving a stone each; a reaper of the Harvest Hand who walked in from the Grey only to look at her.
questSeeds: Someone has to decide what the Unfinished are owed, and Orsolya cannot
One of the people who tried to bring Orsolya back is still alive, and has come to the cairn
Orsolya will hold the Last Cairn for whoever gives her the better argument, and has not heard one yet
appearance: A tall cairn of grey stones on open scree, the last of a line of smaller cairns running back toward the town. Beyond it the ground is ash to the horizon. A grey woman stands beside it in burial linen.
_placed_20261007: Aevi, 2026-10-07. Probed with po/tools/probe_ground.mjs before placing: land, biome scree, region vote `the_palelands`; Cairnsend 0.53° (0.9 days, inside SNG-398's one day and outside the 0.5° suppression, so it still shows at region scale), the Long Grey 1.1° (1.8 days).
_why_20261007: ⛑ ORSOLYA'S HOME, AND THE REGION MAP ALREADY KNEW THE NAME. `the_palelands` region map carried The Last Cairn as `namedGround` (a point, bearing 25°, 717 km), and the Long Grey's own seed opens 'Out past the last cairn the tending stops'. ⛔ THE NAMED POINT SAT INSIDE THE TENDING — closer to Cairnhold than the Quiet Ground, which tends the dying — so it contradicted the seed it was named from. The location is placed past the Quiet Ground, at the edge of the Long Grey, and the namedGround entry is retired in the same commit (one name, one mark). Orsolya's `homeLocation` was `the_palelands`, a region.
